entries.title: Proverbs 5:1
segments: ¶My son, attend unto my wisdom, incline thine ear to my understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: that thou mayest keep reflection, and that thy lips may preserve knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:3
segments: For the lips of the strange woman drop honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments: but her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on Sheol.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: Lest she should ponder the path of life, her ways wander, she knoweth not [whither].

entries.title: Proverbs 5:7
segments: And now, children, hearken unto me, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments: lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments: lest strangers be filled with thy wealth, and the fruits of thy toil [come] into the house of a stranger;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:11
segments: and thou mourn in thine end, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: and thou say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:13
segments: and I have not hearkened unto the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to those that instructed me;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: I was well nigh in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments: ¶Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Thy fountains shall be poured forth, as water-brooks in the broadways.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:17
segments: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:18
segments: Let thy fountain be blessed; and have joy of the wife of thy youth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:19
segments: As a lovely hind and a graceful roe, let her breasts satisfy thee at all times: be thou ravished continually with her love.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:20
segments: And why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah, and he pondereth all his paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:22
segments: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:23
segments: He shall die for want of discipline; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
